actions.text: When the application is starting, it checks whether a post-install update is required and, if so, may download and install the latest available update.
The latest update is looked up for the configured branch and current build version via the update service.

rules.text: Nothing happens unless an 'update_required' marker file exists in the app data folder.
The check is skipped unless automatic updates are on, the update mechanism is BuiltIn, and the deployment does not use an external update mechanism.
If no update is available, the marker file is deleted and nothing is installed. If one is available, the marker is deleted before installation starts.

If installation starts, startup waits 30 seconds for the installer, then logs an error and continues normal operation. If installation is cancelled, startup continues. Any exception is logged and startup continues.
Installation fails if the app data folder is the startup folder or inside it.
Unless the mechanism is Script, the startup folder and its UI folder must be writable, otherwise the update fails with a not-writable error.
If the startup folder path ends with '_output' (developer environment), the update is not installed.
A warning about low free space is logged if the total size of the temp location's drive is less than 1 GB (the check uses total size, not free space).
The downloaded package is verified by comparing its SHA256 hash, case-insensitively, with the package's hash. A mismatch fails the update as invalid.
Archives ending in .zip are extracted as zip, and all others as tgz. Zip entries that would extract outside the target folder are rejected.
With the Script mechanism, a script path must be configured and the file must exist, otherwise the update fails.
With the non-script mechanism, if the update client executable does not exist after preparing it, the update is aborted with a warning and not started.
On macOS and Linux the update client gets permissions 755.
The updater is started with the current process id, the quoted sandbox folder, the quoted executing application and the preserved startup arguments.

sideEffects.text: Any old update sandbox folder is deleted, and the update package is downloaded into the sandbox folder in the temp folder and extracted there.

If the package's branch differs from the configured branch, the configuration's Branch is saved with the package's branch. A save failure is only logged. A saved change publishes a config-saved event.
The config-saved event is handled by logging reconfiguration and by the OIDC options change token source.
A backup of type Update is created before installing. It includes the config file, the SQLite database and version info, zipped into the update backup folder.
With the built-in mechanism, the update client folder is moved into the sandbox and the update client process is started. The app announces that Sonarr will restart shortly.
With the Script mechanism, the update client folder is deleted and the configured script is started.

title: Post-install update check on application start

findings.explanation: The code compares the total size of the temp location's drive with 1 GB, not its free space. The log message says 'free space', but the check does not measure free space.
findings.reason: Reworded the rule to say the check compares the drive's total size with 1 GB, not free space.
findings.statementText: A warning is logged if the temp location has less than 1 GB free.
